tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅/ /sog po bka' bcu pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ drung chen kun spangs pa rnams la gdams pa re re bzhugs// blo chos la bskul ba'i gdams pa dgos gsung ba/ nyid mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la babs kyi go ba bzang ba yin pas de thog nas gang thon mdzad pas khyab/ gnad phral du mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod na/ zag bcas 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di nyid la/ /'phral du phun tshogs blang byar snang ba kun/ /'du byed sdug bsngal nyid du rtogs byas nas/ /nges par 'byung ba thar lam rtsa ba yin/ /mar gyur 'gro ba 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher/ /sdug bsngal chu srin mche rnon gtsigs pa yis/ /rgyun du bzung ba 'di dag thar 'dod pa'i/ /snying rje gom pa theg chen rtsa ba yin/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba'i bla ma mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba yi/ /lha tshogs su 'dus gang gi skur mthong nas/ /gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs rtsa ba yin/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i snod bcud snang ba rnams/ /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bor rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam par dag kyang mtshan rtog bsal ba'i phyir/ /lha ru bsgom pa bskyed rim rtsa ba yin/ /dmigs bcas dmigs med thabs lam gang rung gis/ /ye shes skyes tshe de yis snang ba kun/ /byin gyis brlabs nas thams cad ye shes su/ /bsgom pa 'di ni rdzogs rim rtsa ba yin/ /nang du lta ba spros bral rtogs gyur kyang / /yi dam lha bsgom sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs/ /thabs lam zab mo khyad du mi gsod par/ /brtson pas bsgrub pa dngos grub rtsa ba yin/ /theg pa gong 'og nyams len gnad rnams kun/ /gang du 'dus pa'i rtsa ba rtogs gyur kyang / /bag chags mthug po rkyen gyis bslang ba'i tshe/ /shin tu gces pa'i man ngag dran pa dgos/ /rnyed bkur grags pa 'dod pa'i blo skyes te/ /bdag ni rnyed mang bkur sti dang bcas shing / /mang po dga' ba'i snyems pa byung gyur na/ /'chi tshe 'jigs pa skye bas spong ba gces/

/snyigs dus nyon mongs drag pos gang ba yis/ /'khor tshogs bsdu tshe log sgrub byung ba na/ /khyim du gter ltar dga' ba'i blo skyes nas/ /bzod pas byang chub lam du bsgyur ba gces/ /bdag nyid mtho zhing gzhan dag dma' bar ni/ /'dod pa'i blo la 'bras bu bzlog pa'i phyir/ /'gro kun spyi bo'i thod bzhin khur byas nas/ /rtag tu dman cha 'dzin pa shin tu gces/ /bsam pas dman sa 'dzin par 'dod na yang / /bsod nams zhing mchog dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshe/ /gtso bo bstan pa'i rgyan du che ba'i phyir/ /gzhan ngor bkur sti dwang du len pa gces/ /dran pa nyer gzhag gsum po sangs rgyas kyi/ /khyad chos yin yang mos spyi bsgrub dgos pas/ /'khor gyi chon nyan kun spyod rnam pa gnyis/ /chags sdang khong khros dben pa shin tu gces/ /nang du thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams len dang / /phyi ru 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las rnams/ /rlom sems skyes na de nyid phan chung bas/ /byas zhes snyam pa'i rlom sems med pa gces/ /deng sang dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la/ /dus kyi shugs kyi bar chod stobs che bas/ /de dag bzlog phyir mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi /bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor rgyun du bya ba gces/ /lam gyi rtsa ba rnam bdun dang / /de la gces pa rnam bdun la/ /blo chen khyed kyis 'bad gyur na/ /'dod pa'i don mchog 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes yi ge'i rten mtshon par rje sems dpa' chen po'i gdung thal las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gcig dang bdud rtsi ril bu gcig la rtags 'di 'byar ba phul/ hor zla lnga pa'i nyer bzhi la thub bstan rnam rgyal nas phul ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //dge'o// ༄/ /dge bshes sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi phyag tu phul ba/ khyed khams bzang par yul phyogs su sleb yod 'dug ba legs/ spyir spros pa thams cad bcad nas dge sbyor la dril ba 'thad/

'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog byung ba'i tshe dran shes bzhin gyis zin par byas nas mgo snyoms pa 'thad/ rlom sems byung na dge rtsa chud zos su 'gro bas nga'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog med pa 'thad/ mi sems dang bstun drags na gzhan gyi ngo mi zin pa'i steng du rang don nyams pas blo thag gcad pa 'thad/ ha cang gzhan dang ma mthun na mtha' mi 'khyongs pas gzhan dang 'grogs dus rang lugs su gzhag pa 'thad/ gsang sngags kyi nyams len thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba 'thad/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad pa byed pa 'thad/ snyigs ma'i dus su chos tshul bzhin du byed pa la bar chad 'byung bas mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bsnyen sgrub byed pa 'thad/ gdams pa'i rgyal po 'thad pa brgyad ldan 'di/ /dad cing brtson pas tshul bzhin nyams blangs na/ /gang du gnas kyang rang sems bshes gnyen yin/ /dal 'byor lus la 'dun ma grub par mdzod/ /dad pa'i rten du sems dpa' chen po'i gdung thal las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dngul gyis brgyan pa gcig yod/ khyi lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshe bcu la thub bstan rnam rgyal nas phul/ /dge'o// ༄/ /na mo gu ra we/ mtha' yas 'gro la dmigs pa'i thugs rje dang / /mtha' bral yang dag lta ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i pha mtha' bgrod mkhas pa/ /ded dpon mtshungs med rje btsun bla ma rgyal/ /gang zhig rtogs shing goms dang legs spyad na/ /'khrul med lam gyi them skas legs 'dzegs nas/ /rnam grol thar pa'i khang bzang rtser son pa'i/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gdams pa bshad par bya/ /nyin par bag chags gnyid kyis bslad pa las/ /rmi lam 'khrul snang byung ba dper byas nas/ /ji ltar snang ba 'di dag thog med pa'i/ /bag chags las byung sems snang yin par spyad/ /rdzas sngags kyis ni sna tshogs sgyu ma yi/ /rnam 'phrul ji snyed 'byung ba dper byas nas/

/sems snang 'di dag las kyi rgyu rkyen gyis/ /snang ba tsam yin ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /ngo bos stong pa'i rang sems yod med dang / /bden dang mi bden rtag chad skye 'gag sogs/ /gnyis 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' kun dang bral ba/ /thos bsam tshul gyis rtogs bya'i lta ba yin/ /lta ba de nyid dbang dang rim gnyis las/ /byung ba'i ye shes bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nang nas 'char ba'i nyams myong la brten nas/ /rtogs tshul 'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i lugs/ /de nyid g.yo ba med pa'i zhi gnas kyis/ /bying rgod la sogs skyon rnams spang byas nas/ /gzung 'jug gsal dang rgyun chad med par ni/ /dben pa'i gnas su goms pa sgom pa yin/ /lta ba'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i yan lag tu/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya'i dam tshig rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin blang dor ma nor bar/ /tshul bzhin bsrung ba dang po'i spyod pa yin/ /de ltar goms pas mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ /chos brgyad mgo snyoms nyon mongs bzlog pa na/ /bslab dang dbang dang grol ba'i spyod pa yis/ /blang dor med pa spyod pa'i mchog yin no/ /lta sgom spyod pa mthar phyin gyur pa'i tshe/ /shes bya kun la rang snang ye shes kyis/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid mngon gyur pa/ /'di ni re dogs med pa 'bras bu'i mchog /tshe 'dir sred na 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom/ /rang don gnyer na bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom/ /bar chad byung na bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /'di dag sngar gyi lam gyi yan lag yin/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras lam gyi yan lag bcas/ /nyams len gnad kyi gdams pa dang ldan la/ /tshul bzhin sbyin pa'i dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro bas byung chub thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs nas lam mchog sgrub pa la dad pa dang ldan pa drung chen kun spangs pa la/ shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges phul ba'o/

/dge'o// ༄/ /mdo khams la 'bul sdud rdzong dus kyi yi ge oṃ swa sti/ gsung rab kun gyi rgya mtshor gnas bcas shing / /dga' bzhi'i nor bus rim gnyis spyi bor mdzes/ /phrin las bzang po'i nor la dbang 'byor pa/ /rje btsun bla ma gdengs can dbang po rgyal/ /nyes pa'i dgra tshogs 'dam bu'i grong khyer bcom/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor gser gyi drwa bas spras/ /zung 'jug bde ba'i yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /ston pa glang po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig thos na mu stegs ri dwags bu/ /skrag mdzad bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs shing / /skal bzang gdul bya'i gangs ri nyer mdzes pa/ /dam chos seng ge'i sgra dbyangs de la 'dud/ /bdud dpung bye bas skem par mi nus shing / /rnam dag bslab gsum padmo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /'byor ldan bsod nams chu bo 'du ba'i gzhi/ /dge 'dun pad mtsho che la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang ste dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang nas mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges mdo khams kyi sa'i char bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi snyan du phul ba/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas mi'i gzugs su sprul pa des/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad sgrub 'dus pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srol mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang / khams gsum gyi sems can la phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir du yi dam lha'i lung bstan bzhin dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi dgon pa btab/ rgya bod kyi rten byin rlabs can phyag tu byung ba rnams dang / gsar du bzhengs pa lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i sku tshan pa gsum dang / bstan pa'i gtso bo'i gser sku ches che ba la sogs pa'i rten gsum ngo mtshar ba byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar ba rnams kyi drung du mar me'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas phul du byung ba dang /

rje btsun gong ma bzhi'i dus chen gyi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad/ rje bla ma bde ba can du gshegs pa'i rjes su/ chos rje mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / sa chen gyi zhal gzigs pa de dang / rje bla ma yab sras de gnyis kyis dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mngon shes kyis rgyal tshab dam par bskos pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa dang dpon slob gnyis kyis rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i nang rten rje nyid kyi sku 'dra dang / ston pa'i gser sku ches che ba dang / phyi rten bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ gtsang khang gi nang du gser 'bum dang bcas pa bzhengs te de dag gi drung du'ang mar me'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas gsar du btsugs/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nyer lnga la zla mchod dang / dus chen la bde dgyes gsang gsum la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po lnga'i sgrub mchod zhag grangs mang po sbrel ba btsugs pa 'di ni mthong ba thams cad kyis mngon sum du grub kyang dad ldan rnams kyi dad pa gsal 'debs pa'i phyir bris pa yin/ nged kyang rta nag rin chen rtse thub bstan rnam par rgyal pa'i dgon par sde snod gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan stobs che ba tshugs yod na'ang / ngor pa'i slob dpon che sgres/ las tshan gyi grwa pa thams cad kyi gdan sa byed dgos gsung ba nan ches bas bzlog ma nus pa dang / rje bla ma yab sras kyis sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa la bya ba byed tshul cha shas re la bsams na'ang sku drin 'khor med dran nas ma 'ongs pa na 'dir 'gyur gyi lhus things pa med kyang / gzhan bya thabs kyang ma rnyed/ blos dor yang ma nus pas yos lo hor zla dang po'i tshes lnga'i nyin nas gdan sa'i khur blangs pa yin/ nged kyis rang sar bab pa'i khur khur ba 'di bzhin du/ dad ldan gyi slob tshogs dam tshig gi rgyan gyis mdzes shing rnam dpyod kyi bzhin ras gsal ba thams cad kyis kyang rang sar bab pa'i khur khur dgos/

de'i don spyir dam pa'i chos kyi bshad sgrub la brtson pa yin na'ang / da lan skabs su bab pa sngar gi dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang / dus mchod kyi rgyun rnams mi nyams pa'i phyir dang / de la brten nas bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyed 'byung ba'i phyir dang / 'byor ldan rnams kyi rgyu che chung gang phul yang ji srid dkar me dang / dus mchod kyi rgyun ma chad kyi bar du rgya mtsho chen po la chu thigs ltar dbyer med du 'dres par 'gyur bas de dag la'ang phan gdags pa'i phyir du 'bul sdud la sa skya bka' bcu pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpon slob btang yod pa la rang rang gi phyag rdzas gang 'byor 'bul ba/ skabs su bab pa'i sbyin bdag bskul ba/ 'gro 'dug gi skyel bsu/ grogs ldan gyi mi go chod gang dgos sar gtong ba rnams mdzad par zhu/ 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa rnams kyi nang nas/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su bsnyen bkur zhabs thog dang / 'das pa'i rjes su dus kyi mchod pa gzung ba 'di nyid bsod nams che ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ gur/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bla ma la rag las pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i bsod nams bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig la mthong ba la sogs mang du gsungs/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis kyang / mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang gis bskal pa bye bar ni/ /brgya phrag tu yang rnyed dka' ba/ /de nyid sangs rgyas brtson ldan la/ /skye ba 'dir ni stsol bar mdzad/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i zhal nas kyang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma la 'dus pas bla ma gcig pu la gsol ba btab pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba btab par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang /

rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar na 'di dpon slob kyi lag tu gang 'phrod e wam̐ du 'phrod nges yin pas chud mi za/ e wam̐ du gang 'phrod bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pas ngo bo bzang ba dang / dus mchod kyi rgyun la 'dres pas thabs rgya che bar shes par byas nas rang rang gi 'byor pa'i stobs bzhin dad pa dang brtson pas dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par mdzod cig zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing / /yan lag rab rgyas rin chen rgyan phreng ldan/ /khams gsum 'dod pa kun la dbang sgyur ba/ /'dod pa'i rgyal pos don 'di dge legs mdzod/ /'od zer dmar po'i phreng bas srid gsum gsal/ /utpal dmar po'i mda' gzhus khams gsum 'gugs/ /khro chags bzhad pa'i spyan zur g.yo ba can/ /rig byed lha mo de yis dge legs mdzod/ /glang chen zhal ldan 'dzum khro'i mche ba gtsigs/ /gzhon nu lang tsho dar dmar cod paṇa bcings/ /bcu gnyis phyag can zhabs gnyis 'gying bag can/ /khro rgyal de yis don 'di'i dge legs mdzod/ /rje btsun brgyud par bcas pa thams cad kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /srung ma'i dbang po bgrang yas thams cad kyis/ /'gal rkyen bsal zhing mthun rkyen grub par mdzod/ /yos lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin dge zhing bkra shis pa'i yi ge 'di mdo khams shar gyi phyogs su phul ba dge/ //dge'o// ༄/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gyad gnyer dge ru gsum gyi yon bdag rnams kyis thub bstan rnam rgyal du sngar 'bri 'bul ba'i ched mdzad pa rnams dang / da dung 'bul bar 'gyur ba rnams ngo mtshar che zhing rjes su yi rang / 'phral du nged 'chad nyan byed pa'i mthun rkyen du 'gro bas phan zhing / phugs khyed rang rnams la phan pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan longs spyod don yod pa sbyin pa yin/

lus don yod pa phyag dang bskor ba yin/ ngag don yod pa gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod yin/ sems don yod pa dad pa dang snying rje bsgom pa yin/ dal 'byor don yod pa chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa yin/ chos sgrub pa la'ang khyim pa'i rten la sgrub pa dang rab byung gi rten la sgrub pa gnyis las/ phyi ma thos bsam sgom gsum la gtso bor 'bad pa yin kyang de khyim pa rnams kyis mi yong / khyim pa'i rten la bsgrub rgyu don yod dang po bzhi po yin/ longs spyod don yod pa'i sbyin pa'ang sbyin pa rnam dag cig dgos/ sbyin pa rnam dag tu 'gyur ba'i tshad sbyin bdag dad pa dang ldan pa dang / dngos po bzang zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / zhing khyad par du 'phags pa gsum yin par mdo las bshad/ de'i dang po ni khyed rang rnams 'bri 'bul ba'i kun slong bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa dang / nye 'brel dus las 'das pa rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thon pa dang / rang nyid kyang thar pa'i lam sna zin pa'i ched du 'bul bar bya'o snyam pa de yin/ dngos po phun sum tshogs pa ni dkon mchog gi dkar me dang / dge 'dun gyi gsol tsha'i rdor la sogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi 'bri bzang po phul ba de yin/ zhing phun sum tshogs pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag dang / pha ma dang / nad pa dang / chos smra ba la phul ba'i yon gzhal du med par gsungs pa'i nang nas/ 'dir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'chad nyan 'ba' zhig byed pa'i chos smra ba sha dag yin pas sbyin pa'i zhing shin tu bzang ba yin/ de ltar sbyin bdag dad pas kun nas bslangs pa/ dngos po bzang po rang dbang ba'i nor yin pa/ zhing dam pa chos smra ba'i gang zag la phul ba'i sbyin pa 'di ni tshe phyi mar yi dwags su skye ba gcod/ mir skyes na'ang dbul zhing phongs pa rnams gcod/ skye ba thams cad du longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thob/

mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa'i sgo nas sems can mang po sdud pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ mdo bsdus pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod/ /dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod/ /spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed/ /ces rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdul bya thams cad la thugs brtse ba can des gsungs pa'o/ /des na yon bdag rnams kyang rab tu byung nas thos bsam byed pa ma byung yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa yin pas/ chos byed lugs mang du yod pa yin te/ blo phugs skyabs gnas bla ma dang dkon mchog la gtod/ skyabs 'gro mang du gyis/ tshe phyi ma 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob/ tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba yin/ nam dal dus su ma ṇi padme bgrongs/ thugs rje chen po 'di bod kyi lha skal yin pas byin rlabs tshad las myur ba yin/ dge 'dun zhing dag pa la bsnyen bkur gyis/ bsod nams bsag pa'i zhing mchog yin par sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yin/ bkren pa dang / dbul phongs dang / nad pa rnams la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs phan gang thogs gyis/ zhing ngan yang bsam pa rnam par dag pas 'bras bu bzang po 'byung bar slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis gsungs pa yin/ pha ma rgan rgon la zhabs tog tshul bzhin du gyis/ 'di stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgoms pa dang bsod nams mnyam par jo bo rjes gsungs pa yin/ don med pa'i ri dwags gsod pa sogs srog gcod/ lam 'grul nyam chung brdung ba sogs ma byed/ srog gcod dang ma byin len la sogs pa mi dge ba bcu'i 'bras bu ngan song du skye bar gsungs pa yin/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas gzhan la gnod pa spong ci nus dang / gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa ci nus gyis/

chos kyi ngo bo gzhan la mi gnod pa dang gzhan la phan pa yin/ 'di dag la go ba skyes nas nyams len byas na rang nyid 'jig rten gyi nye 'brel dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma spangs bzhin du tshe phyi ma rang la phan pa'i chos 'grub pa yin/ 'di nged kyi rang 'dod la brten pa'i kha mkhas mkhas min/ da lan gyad gnyer dge ru gsum gyi rgan gzhon thams cad kyi mdun du tshar re bklags pas go ba yod pa rnams la dge ba'i bag chags gzhag nged kyis kyang chos bshad pa'i skal bar 'gro ba yin/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa yis/ /gyad gnyer dge gsum yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /ngan song gsum gyi gnas las thar bar shog /khyad par rnam dag sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /dkon mchog skyabs 'gro gzungs sngags bgrang ba dang / /gzhan la gnod pa spong ba'i skye bo rnams/ /bde chen thar pa'i lam sna zin par shog /tshe 'dir dgra dang chom rkun gnod pa dang / /yams nad la sogs nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /tshe dang rigs rgyud rtag tu rgyas par shog /sa pho khyi'i lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad la thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon pa nas dge/ // ༄/ /dpon drung chen po'i drung du zhu ba/ deng sang sku khams bzang bar bzhugs lags sam/ snga sor zhu yig re tsam 'bul 'dod yod lags na'ang / 'phrod dka' bar 'dug zer ba thos nas ma phul ba lags/ da nang so nas kyang thugs tshas dor ba cig nam yang mi 'char/ rgyal mkhar rtse nas kyang bzu med du gtong ba'i dgongs pa cig ye med mchi na'ang / bya 'gro sa gzhi ches pa'i stobs kyis myur lam du thon pa cig ma byung / da dung kyang zla ba gcig gnyis tsam 'gyang tshod du 'dug na yang / phugs skyon du 'gro ba rang gcig mi yong las che lags/ spyir 'jig rten gyi bya ba la tshe phyi ma lta smos kyang ci dgos/

tshe 'di la yang snying po med pa 'di gas gsal/ snying po yod na dgung lo bdun cu phan chad la kha drag pa/ dbang che ba/ 'khor g.yog dang nor rdzas 'dzom pa nyams su myong yang / da 'di 'dra cig tu yod tsa na de dag gang gis kyang phan pa med pa'i steng du gnod pa 'ba' zhig 'gro ba lags/ de bas kyang tshe phyi ma shul thag ring / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med/ las bzang ngan gang bsags kyi rnam smin rang gis myong dgos/ der bzhugs pa dang / tshur thon pa gang byung kyang da tshe mjug 'di la yun ring po med/ rgyu mtshan des na da spyir bdag 'dzin dang khyad par tshe 'di blos thong / na ning zla ba brgyad pa nas deng sang gi bar du sdig pa tshabs po che bsog mi dgos pa 'di yang / dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin snyam pa mdzod la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la yid ches pa'i dad pas skyabs 'gro lan mang du bya/ de rjes thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong ba bdag tu 'dzin pas lan/ nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad kyi sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma 'ba' zhig yin pas bdag 'dzin thul ba dang / drin lan gzhal dgos snyam du bsam/ de la thabs gzhan mi 'dug pas/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyu mi dge ba dang / 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig bdag gi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad sems can la smin par gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsgoms/ 'di bsgom sla zhing theg pa chen po'i chos kyi yang snying yang yin/ jo bo rjes 'brom ston pa kho na la gnang ba'i chos kyang 'di yin/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /zhes gsungs/ zhi ba lhas/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces gsungs/ grub chen bi rū pas/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/

/bdag gi bde bas de dag bde thob shog /ces gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin pas/ thugs dam gyi snying po mdzad par zhu/ drung 'tsho byed pa dang phyogs cig tu bzhugs yod 'dug pa yi ge zur pa med pas 'di ga ston par zhu/ da lan gsol ja zho gang dang / gsol bur sgar mtshon gcig la rtags 'byar chos rje rkyang 'dur ba brgyud nas phul yod pa 'phrod du re/ sbrul lo hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer brgyad la e waṃ nas zhus/ na ning dbus nas phebs 'phral phyag rdzas gang yod kyi phyed tsam dge rtsa la btang na 'di la ma thug tsam cig yong ba yin na'ang de dus snyan bskul 'gro ba'i sgo mi 'dug da lan gyi thugs dam gyi bskul ma 'di rnams thugs la 'chang ba zhu/ zhes dpon drung g.yung pa la gdams pa'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 go bo rab 'byams pa/ sog po bka' bcu pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ drung chen kun spangs pa rnams la gdams pa re re bzhugs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
